messages.subject: About Rqtl-announce
messages.body_plain:
This group will serve solely for announcements regarding updates,
bugs, and bug fixes for the QTL mapping software, R/qtl.  Only the
moderator (me) can post messages to the group.

A separate group, R/qtl discussion
(http://groups-beta.google.com/group/Rqtl-disc), has been created for
sending general discussion of the use of R/qtl.  That group accepts
posts by any members.

Everything I post to this announcements group will also be posted to
the
discussion group, so there's no need to join both groups.  Join the
announcements group if you want just announcements, and join the
discussion group if you want more.
Karl Broman
http://www.biostat.jhsph.edu/~kbroman/qtl

messages.subject: R/qtl version 0.98-56
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (0.98-56) has been released at its web site
(http://www.biostat.jhsph.edu/~kbroman/qtl).  An enormous number of
changes have been made over the year since the previous release,
especially concerning the X chromosome.  See
http://www.biostat.jhsph.edu/~kbroman/qtl/STATUS.txt for a complete
list of changes.

Karl Broman
